events.text: Strikes on infrastructure in Crimea since late May: over 70% of an estimated 2.5–3M residents hit by power cuts; water in the largest cities limited to 1–2 hours a day.
Donetsk region's last maternity hospital (Sloviansk) closed after a nearby airstrike on 8 June.
Attacks on 24 May, 2 June and 15 June used over 1,860 drones and 230 missiles; 41,000 Kyiv residents sheltered in the metro on 2 June.
Kostiantynivka: about 2,500 remaining residents rely on two working wells.
Oleshky (occupied Kherson oblast, ~2,000 residents) cut off by mined roads; last food delivery 17 February.
Front line within 15 km of Sloviansk–Kramatorsk; over 600 people evacuated from Sloviansk in late March.
Strikes on 19 January left 5,600+ Kyiv high-rises without power, heating or water; first national energy emergency declared. Grid ran a ~40% capacity deficit (11 of 18 GW).
